value.rationale: Determines every homology dimension of a natural infinite two-terminal digraph family for all N and all q, exhibiting an arithmetic root-order phase and an independent higher-chain phase controlled by two-edge branches. This joint structural exactness is a reusable benchmark for a newly published graph-homology theory, not an arbitrary selected finite slice.
